{{Top}}
'''Kalaks''' were nimble, quadrupedal animals native to the planet [[Roon/Legends|Roon]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|1|194|Kalak}}</ref> They were known for their fast overland traveling speeds,<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> reaching up to 60 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour|hour]] unladen at full gallop,<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> making them common choices as mounts for messengers carrying information or goods. Kalaks had many prominent [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]<ref name="TUR" /> protruding at odd angles from their jaws that allowed to to eat low-lying tree leaves<ref name="GATORW" /> by stripping them from low branches,<ref name="CSWE" /> though they could be used defensively to tear flesh from aggressors.<ref name="TUR" />
